critical_corrections: Require a true TS optimization before higher-level single-point refinement because the current NEB geometry is not an accepted stationary point/barrier.
Label the ~50.9 kcal/mol biased-window maximum as potentially overestimating the true barrier, not a settled activation free energy.
Label N-terminal amine-assisted activation as homolog-based hypothesis; no Nyl12 Thr N deprotonation evidence is present.
Acknowledge computed 0 K/300 K versus assay 75 C temperature mismatch.
Treat Lys156 catalytic-base role as unsupported hypothesis; substrate-bound geometry is also unavailable for validating direct Oγ-to-leaving-N distances.

recommendation_basis: A single RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q 96-GB-class card has sufficient nominal VRAM for the already-provisioned 65.4-GB MXFP4 model artifact; serve the 120B model on one card with the recorded 64k context/32k output limits and retain the second card for independent work. The two GPUs are not an NVLink-pooled 192-GB device. Hardware fit does not establish pathway-review scientific reliability; critic flagged five corrections and review remains pending PI decision.
